latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Quickly turn text scripts into TikTok-ready videos using AI voiceover and cloud rendering.

- Converts TXT, DOCX, PDF, or SRT files (up to 200MB) into 1080p TikTok videos with voiceover and captions.
- Easy authentication with automatic free token generation for new users (100 free credits, valid 7 days).
- Fast cloud-based processing: most videos ready for download in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports batch uploads, timeline editing, audio tracks, and export in popular formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, etc.).
- User-friendly chat prompts guide you through uploading, editing, checking credits/status, and exporting your video.
